🌍 *Walt Disney World Magic Kingdom*

The most magical place on Earth for families. Cinderella Castle, classic rides, character meet-and-greets, parades, and fireworks across six immersive lands including Fantasyland designed for young children.

*📋 Quick Facts:*
• 👶 Age range: 2-14
• 🕐 Best time: January-early March, September-November weekdays
• 💰 Price: $$$$
• ⭐ Safety rating: 4.9/5
• 🏷️ Category: Theme Parks & Attractions

*💡 Tips & Tricks:*
• Book Genie+ the night before at midnight.
• Use Baby Care Center on Main Street for diaper changes - cleaner and has rocking chairs.
• Ride Peter Pan's Flight first - 60+ min wait all day.
• Character dining at Crystal Palace is worth every cent for toddlers.

*📖 My 3-year-old met Cinderella and forgot how to speak*
> When Cinderella knelt and said 'hello, princess,' my daughter stared silently and burst into tears. The best kind of tears.
— Rachel, mom of 1 from Dallas

content.content:
🌍 *Tokyo Disneyland*

The ultimate family destination with classic Disney magic. Two incredible parks with exceptional safety standards, stroller rentals, baby care centers, and numerous family-friendly restaurants.

*📋 Quick Facts:*
• 👶 Age range: 3-12
• 🕐 Best time: Weekdays, September-November
• 💰 Price: $$$
• ⭐ Safety rating: 4.9/5
• 🏷️ Category: Theme Parks & Attractions

*💡 Tips & Tricks:*
• Go on a Tuesday or Wednesday — weekend crowds are 3x worse and you'll spend half your day in line.
• Bring your own snacks. The park allows outside food and a packed lunch saves $40+ per person.
• Use the Disney Resort app to book 'Priority Pass' slots — they're free and save 60-90 minutes of waiting per ride.
• The Baby Care Centers have private nursing rooms, microwaves for bottles, and vending machines with formula.

*📖 The meltdown that turned into our best memory*
> Our 4-year-old screamed for 20 minutes outside Space Mountain. Too short. Too scary. We almost left. Then a cast member took us to the backlot to watch the parade setup. She spent an hour waving at characters. That moment — a stranger's kindness — saved our day.
— Sarah, mom of 2 from Melbourne
